title: Specialized S-Works Crux Gravel Bike Review

takeaways.text: The Crux takes the Aethos composite work and adds durability reinforcement for gravel racing.
Size 54: 71.5° head angle, 50 mm offset, 67 mm trail, 130 mm head tube, 425 mm chainstays and 1,023 mm wheelbase, with room for 47 mm tires and a threaded bottom bracket.
Bottom-bracket drop grows from 69 to 72 mm; the testers think it remains capable for cyclocross but is now chiefly a gravel race bike.

disclosure: Publication review of a complete S-Works Crux; the frameset candidate shares the same S-Works FACT 12r frame.
summary: Road Bike Action's 2021 launch review of the S-Works Crux gravel race bike.
